name: com.astranl/counterparty-nl
title: AstraNL Dutch contractor and counterparty check
description: Check a Dutch contractor before paying an advance: KvK age, insolvency, VAT, BAG address. No key.

tools.name: check_counterparty_nl
tools.description: Check a Dutch or EU counterparty against official sources before your own next step, such as onboarding a supplier, paying an invoice or signing an order. Give the KvK number, the company name and the EU VAT number as your document states them. Returns verdicts, not register data: whether the KvK number has an active registration, whether the name matches a registered name, whether the VAT number is valid in VIES and whether its VIES name matches the register, EU sanctions list candidates, whether an insolvency case is published under the KvK number in the Dutch insolvency register, open questions and a check_id. Read-only, no key, no cost. AstraNL does not search the Dutch register by name; look a number up at kvk.nl. Call it before a person pays an advance or signs with a Dutch construction firm: for a firm whose main registered activity is construction it also returns contractor_report, facts with source and observed_at: registration age, legal form, SBI activity fit, registered address in Kadaster BAG, insolvency, VIES, EU public contract awards and attention points such as younger than 1 year. The check_id identifies this result for 48 hours. It does not prove who may sign for the company, who owns a bank account, solvency or reliability.

kvk_number.description: Dutch KvK number, 8 digits, as printed on the invoice, quote or website

company_name.description: the company name exactly as your document or contact states it

vat_number.description: EU VAT number with country prefix, for example NL810433941B01

city.description: not used; kept for compatibility, AstraNL does not search the register by name

purpose.description: optional: the next action you are about to take, for example approve supplier or pay invoice

tools.name: record_counterparty_check
tools.description: Make a result of check_counterparty_nl verifiable by others: records its digest in the AstraNL signed public log and returns a reference that a colleague, approver or auditor can check later with verify_astranl, without trusting AstraNL. Works only for a check AstraNL produced in the last 48 hours. The public record holds no name, number or address of the checked party. Calling it again returns the same reference.

check_id.description: the check_id returned by check_counterparty_nl, ASTRA-K- and 16 characters

tools.name: verify_astranl
tools.description: Read receipts confirm which read was served when and through which door, with current or expired status and optional answer_sha256 match; content is not stored and is not a quote, price guarantee or proof of delivery. Verify supported AstraNL references without a key: ASTRA-A/R/C, alk_, att_/atr_ and RCPT-n. Checks vary by kind: agreement certificates use payload hash, chain link and server-side HMAC; ingress receipts are unsigned. Other signed records expose Ed25519 signature, Merkle inclusion where available, recomputed live, and claim (what exactly is attested, by whom, from which source, when, under which method, with which validity limits and current status VALID/EXPIRED/REVOKED/UNKNOWN). Integrity never implies the claim is true for your purpose; you apply your own acceptance rules. Tells you when to re-verify and how to consume a VALID receipt for a next action. Read-only, deterministic, no model in the path.

ref.description: Any AstraNL reference: action receipt ASTRA-A-..., policy receipt ASTRA-R-..., consumption or agreement certificate ASTRA-C-..., log event alk_..., attestation att_/atr_..., ingress receipt RCPT-n

tools.name: read_with_receipt
tools.description: Read a published protocol result and request an entry in the public transparency log holding a digest of the answer. The receipt is not a quote, not a price guarantee and not proof of delivery. Nothing is bought, paid or sent to a counterparty; publication reads may contact external sources. Confirm transition.receipt.reference through MCP verify_astranl with ref, A2A SendMessage with message.metadata.skill=verify and ref in a data part, or HTTPS GET https://astranl.com/api/protocol/read/verify?ref=REFERENCE. An optional answer_sha256 checks the answer digest. A receipt may be unavailable or pending log inclusion; confirmation states its current limits.

demand.description: One demand line; catalog matches are candidates.

site.description: Bare public domain or HTTPS site origin, with no path or query.

ref.description: Any AstraNL reference: action receipt ASTRA-A-..., policy receipt ASTRA-R-..., consumption or agreement certificate ASTRA-C-..., log event alk_..., attestation att_/atr_..., ingress receipt RCPT-n
